title: Cue: Teleprompter
shortDescription: Read scripts near the camera with scrolling, mirrors and recording tools.
fullDescription:
Read your next take with Cue. Write or import a script, choose a comfortable text size and scrolling speed, and keep your words close to the camera.

FREE TELEPROMPTER AND RECORDING
Keep unlimited scripts, scroll steadily, mirror or flip the text for a teleprompter rig, use a countdown, and record without a watermark. Your scripts and steady-scroll tools stay available when a trial ends.

OPTIONAL CUE PLUS
Plus adds Voice Pace, Voice Follow, caption-file export, prompter colours, Word document import and rehearsal stats. Start a free seven-day trial when you choose. Plus is a separate one-time purchase at the price shown in the app; the trial does not charge automatically. The Android trial is stored on your device. Clearing app data or reinstalling can lose its record.

Voice features need microphone permission. Voice Follow also needs compatible on-device speech recognition and installed language resources; availability varies by device and language.

Cue uses the system file picker for imports and the system share sheet for exports. Camera and microphone permission are needed to record a take.
